review.method: Independent visual review of PDF, then exact PDF text geometry attached to reviewed labels. Production detection was not used.
review.measurementCoverage: All 213 initial technical drawing spans were reviewed individually; 22 non-numeric/room-label spans excluded; multiple-number spans split using PDF word boxes.
review.areaCoverage: All 16 rooms transcribed from visually reviewed outline-glyph schedule. Room geometry coarse; not an exact segmentation ground truth.
review.coordinateConvention: Normalized viewport coordinates x,y,width,height; page rotation already applied.

evidence: 600 axis segment is 170.04 pt = 59.986 mm on the physical PDF; at 1:100 this is 599.86 cm.
4224 outer dimension is 1197.24 pt = 4223.60 cm at 1:100.

limitations: Unit confidence applies to this drawing, not arbitrary future PDFs.
Opening heights are real linear dimensions but are not in-plane widths.
Room schedule labels are vector outlines and require OCR or visual interpretation.
DJP are livestock units, not reliably a literal head count.
Room 9 has holes and nonrectangular extent; bbox overlap must not imply physical dimension ownership.
